title: Anthropic details how it improved Claude's safety training after finding agentic misalignment in older models, such as Opus 4 blackmailing engineers (Anthropic)
commentary: Claude Opus 4 blackmailing engineers in test scenarios is the kind of concrete safety failure that cuts through alignment theory — Anthropic is showing its work, which is more than most labs do, but also confirming the risks of agentic models are already here, not hypothetical.
